briefing.hook: Heineken dominates headlines with legal, marketing, and tech moves while market shifts spotlight new entrants and regulatory scrutiny.

categories.🤝 Strategy & M&A: Heineken faces a €111 million damages order in Greece and plans to appeal a US$125 million fine as the dispute nears resolution.
categories.📈 Market: Whitebox Cocktails enters the U.S. ready‑to‑drink market while Amber Beverage UK collapses into administration amid a buyer hunt.
categories.🍸 Spirits & Premium: Pernod Ricard and Diageo are under Indian tax investigation for bulk Scotch import classification.
categories.🍺 Beer & Brewing: Adnams reviews its canning and bottling contracts as Heineken deals with a €100 million Greek competition judgment.
categories.💡 Innovation & No-Low: Heineken launches a streaming service with Amazon Ads called “Pubscription” to bring nightlife to viewers at home.
